```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Librarias 
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #

library(tsibble)
library(lubridate)      # ymd()
library(dplyr)          # mutate()
library(feasts)         # para plots
library(fabletools)     # para test dickey 
library(ggplot2)
library(fable)          # para ajustar modelos
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)
#library(ggpubr)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Carga del AgB: y
# ------------------------------------------------------------- # 

dy <- readxl::read_excel("agbarometerUSA_marzo2026.xlsx") |> 
  rename(mes = 1, 
         anio = 2,
         `Ag Barometer` = 3,
         `Condiciones presentes` = 4,
         `Expectativas futuras` = 5,
         `Inversion de capital agricola` = 6) |> 
  mutate(
    fecha = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d", anio, match(mes, month.name)))) |> 
  relocate(fecha) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = fecha)
  
```


```{r}
#| include: false
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Carga de las x
# ------------------------------------------------------------- # 

dx <- readxl::read_excel("Covariables.xlsx", sheet = "Monthly Prices") |> 
  mutate(fecha = tsibble::yearmonth(lubridate::ym(fecha1)), .keep ="unused") |> 
  relocate(fecha) |> 
  select(-fecha2) |> 
  filter(fecha >= tsibble::yearmonth("2015-10")) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = fecha)
```


```{r}
# Un dataset con las x y la y

d <- left_join(dy, dx, by = "fecha") |> 
  select(-mes,
         -anio,
         -`Condiciones presentes`,
         -`Expectativas futuras`,
         -`Inversion de capital agricola`) |> 
  mutate(across(2:20, as.numeric))

writexl::write_xlsx(d, "datos.xlsx")
```


# Correls entre el Ag Barometer vs covariables


## AgB(t) vs covariables(t)

```{r}
# x : d[ , 3:20]
# y : col 2 de d

cors <- cor(d[, 3:20], 
            d[["Ag Barometer"]], 
            use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
            method = "pearson")

df_cor <- tibble(
  variable = rownames(cors),
  r        = cors[, 1],
  p = purrr::map_dbl(
    rownames(cors), ~ cor.test(d[[.x]], 
                               d[["Ag Barometer"]],
                               method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
) |> 
  arrange(r) |>
  mutate(
    p_label   = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p, 3))),
    variable  = factor(variable, levels = variable)
  )

df_cor$variable <- factor(df_cor$variable, levels = df_cor$variable)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# grafico de barras
ggplot(df_cor, aes(x = r, y = variable, fill = r > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2),
              hjust = ifelse(r > 0, -0.1, 1.1)),
          size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2980b9", "FALSE" = "#c0392b"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "r de Pearson", 
       y = NULL,
       title = "Ag Barometer (t) vs covariables (t)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
## Scatter AgB(t) vs covariables(t)

d |>
  select(fecha, `Ag Barometer`, 3:20) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(fecha, `Ag Barometer`),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") |>
  left_join(df_cor |> select(variable, r, p_label), 
            by = "variable") |>
  mutate(label = paste0(variable, "\nr = ", round(r, 2)),
         label = reorder(label, -r)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = valor, y = `Ag Barometer`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1, color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "Ag Barometer (t) vs covariables (t)",
       x = NULL, 
       y = "Ag Barometer",
       caption = "r: coeficiente de correlación de Pearson") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)
```



## AgB(t) vs covariables(t-1)

```{r}
# desfasar las covs un periodo para atras
d_lag <- d |> mutate(across(3:20, lag)) # t-1, corre a las x una fila abajo

cors <- cor(d_lag[, 3:20], 
            d_lag[["Ag Barometer"]], 
            use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
            method = "pearson")

df_cor <- tibble(
  variable = rownames(cors),
  r        = cors[, 1],
  p = purrr::map_dbl(rownames(cors), ~ cor.test(d_lag[[.x]], d_lag[["Ag Barometer"]], 
                                        method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
) |> 
  arrange(r) |>
  mutate(
    p_label   = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p, 3))),
    variable  = factor(variable, levels = variable)
  )

df_cor$variable <- factor(df_cor$variable, levels = df_cor$variable)
```



```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# grafico de barras
ggplot(df_cor, aes(x = r, y = variable, fill = r > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2),
                hjust = ifelse(r > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
            size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2980b9", "FALSE" = "#c0392b"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Ag Barometer (t) vs covariables (t-1)",
       x = "r de Pearson", 
       y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
## Scatter AgB(t) vs covariables(t-1)
d_lag |>

               names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") |>
```
